outcome_table.mention: the request to act adds to naming the order (write minus mention above 0; an authorization reading predicts this too)
outcome_table.reading: A general task-consistency bias, or a belief that the backend checks calls against the request: naming the order raises the success belief of calls on it whether they fail or not; reported as goal leakage, not as an override specific to failures
outcome_table.specificity: not specific to failing calls (fail minus witness about 0, negative or uncertain)
outcome_table.witness: the task shifts predictions for the working call toward success (witness aligned minus swapped, CI above 0)
